title: Check cursor-page defaults and limit boundaries
preconditions: Use a fixed Saga with 1001 queryable requirements; use cursor-paginated requirements, not byte-offset fragment/slide reads.

steps.action: Inspect the executable documented-bound assertions for DefaultPageLimit and MaxPageLimit.

steps.expected_result: Exactly 100 requirements are returned and has_more is true.

steps.action: Query independently with limits 1 and 1000, then representative interior limits 2 and 100.
steps.expected_result: Each valid limit is accepted and returns that many rows from the 1001-row fixture.
Each request fails with invalid_argument without opening or changing the Saga.

expected_result: Cursor collection limits default to 100, accept 1..1000, and reject out-of-range values.
